title: Post-collision velocities
description: Essential: Student must state correct final velocities for P and Q: v_P = 3mg/(5qB) and v_Q = 8mg/(5qB), both to the right.

title: Conservation laws application
description: Important: Student must apply both momentum and kinetic energy conservation for the elastic collision between masses M=4m and m.

title: P's horizontal range
description: Essential: Student must compute the horizontal distance x = v_P * sqrt(2h/g) = (3mg/(5qB)) * sqrt(2h/g).

title: Q's motion decomposition
description: Important: Student must decompose Q's velocity into a uniform horizontal component (v_0) and a circular motion component (3v_0/5) due to the magnetic field.

title: Q's maximum height
description: Essential: Student must find the maximum height H = h + 2R, where R = m*(3v_0/5)/(qB) = (3m^2 g)/(5q^2 B^2).

title: Q's velocity at max height
description: Essential: Student must state that at maximum height, Q's velocity equals its uniform horizontal component: v = v_0 = mg/(qB).

title: Lorentz force as centripetal
description: Important: Student must equate magnetic force qv_perp B to centripetal force m v_perp^2 / R to find the radius of circular motion.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if student assigns wrong direction to post-collision velocities or misinterprets the magnetic force direction.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student performs dimensional analysis to verify expressions for velocity, distance, and height have correct units.
